gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.title: Command Panel
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.lock_hint: Shift + Right-click to lock this command
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.unlock_hin: Shift + Right-click to unlock this command
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.tree_hint: Click an entry to expand/collapse; Esc or the bound key to close
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.a: Grant or revoke player advancements. Usage: /advancement <grant|revoke> <player> <advancement>
Get or modify entity attributes. Usage: /attribute <target> <attribute> <get|base|modifier> ...
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.b: Create, modify or remove bossbars. Usage: /bossbar <add|remove|list|set|get> <id> ...
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.c: Clear items from player inventory. Usage: /clear [player] [item] [count]
Copy blocks from a region. Usage: /clone <start> <end> <destination> [replace|masked|filtered] [force|move|normal]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.d: Deal damage to an entity. Usage: /damage <target> <damage> [<cause>]
Get or modify NBT data of block entities, entities or storage. Usage: /data <get|merge|modify|remove> <target> [path]
Set the default game mode for new players. Usage: /defaultgamemode <survival|creative|adventure|spectator>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.e: Give or clear status effects. Usage: /effect <give|clear> <target> [effect] [seconds] [level] [hideParticles]
Enchant the item in a player's hand. Usage: /enchant <player> <enchantment> [level]
Give or remove player experience. Usage: /experience <add|set|query> <player> <amount>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.x: Give or remove player experience (alias of /experience). Usage: /xp <add|set|query> <player> <amount>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.f: Fill a region with blocks. Usage: /fill <start> <end> <block> [replace|destroy|hollow|keep|outline] [data]
Fill a region with a biome. Usage: /fillbiome <start> <end> <biome>
Force chunks to stay loaded. Usage: /forceload <add|remove|query> [pos]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.g: Set the game mode of a player. Usage: /gamemode <survival|creative|adventure|spectator> [player]
Query or set game rules. Usage: /gamerule <rule> [value]
Give an item to a player. Usage: /give <player> <item> [count]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.i: Modify items in inventories or containers. Usage: /item <replace|modify> <target> <slot> ...
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.k: Kick a player from the server. Usage: /kick <player> [reason]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.l: Locate the nearest structure or biome. Usage: /locate <structure|biome|poi> <name>
Spawn and distribute loot. Usage: /loot <give|insert|spawn|replace> <target> <loot source>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.t: Message a player privately (alias of /msg). Usage: /tell <player> <message>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.w: Message a player privately (alias of /msg). Usage: /w <player> <message>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.p: Place structures, features etc. at a position. Usage: /place <feature|jigsaw|structure|template> <name> [pos]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.r: Return a value from a function. Usage: /return <value>
Make an entity mount or dismount. Usage: /ride <target> <mount|dismount> [vehicle]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.s: Broadcast a message to all players. Usage: /say <message>
Set a player's spawn point. Usage: /spawnpoint [player] [<pos>] [angle]
Set the world spawn point. Usage: /setworldspawn [<pos>] [angle]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.t: Broadcast a message to the team. Usage: /teammsg <message>
Broadcast a message to the team (alias of /teammsg). Usage: /tm <message>
Send a raw JSON message. Usage: /tellraw <player> <message>
Set or query the time. Usage: /time <set|add|query> <time>
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.p: Open the world to LAN. Usage: /publish [port]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.b: List banned players or IPs. Usage: /banlist [ips|players]
command.star_sword_mod_1785589476.desc.s: Set the idle kick timeout. Usage: /setidletimeout <minutes>
Spawn armor stands with trimmed armor around you. Usage: /spawn_armor_trims
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.title: Mechanic Panel
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.subti: Click a row to toggle that mechanic, effective immediately
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.hint: Left click to toggle · Esc or the key closes
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.anti_: Blocks the Q-key drop and refills the sword (Shift+Z)
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.remov: Clears mobs by removing them from storage (Shift+C)
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.refle: Forces the aimed target's health to zero
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.healt: Locked value overrides all writes; healing cannot break through
gui.star_sword_mod_1785589476.mech.start: Presets apply when you join (sword + permission required)
